title: Common-Freeze
description: Paper plugin to freeze mobs while retaining their perks!
body:
[![CodeFactor](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/craftish37/common-freeze/badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/craftish37/common-freeze)

Very simple plugin that allows to freeze mobs in place while keeping what they can do for the player

For example, frozen villagers will be allowed to trade and restock for the player, allowing both performance gain and gameplay preservation

To freeze a mob, simply right-click a mob with an ice block
